name: Durable Business Outcome Reconciliation
summary: Recover privacy-bounded enquiry and payment evidence independently of customer fulfilment, and reconcile delayed outcomes against exact verified publication identities.
problem: A duplicate payment receipt or successful contact delivery can hide a failed outcome write, while early cursor advancement permanently loses delayed attribution evidence.
coreOutcomes: Durable recovery before advancing source cursors
Verified descriptive attribution with currency separation
requirements: Authorised event sources and immutable fulfilment receipts
Exact publication identity and signed-link provenance
boundaries: Never repeat a charge, enquiry or social publication to recover evidence
A valid payment signature does not authenticate campaign provenance
An empty connected ledger is not zero business activity
Identity correlation does not prove causation
